# Brand survey with an indicator that predicts the outcome: q1 measures
# quality and has an outgoing arrow (recommend ~ q1), so it is an
# endogenous observed inner variable (lavaan's ov.y dummy latent).
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
recommend ~ q1 + value + service
